---
title: "Line Extend by Reference Line"
format: html
---

## Overview

This transform lengthens each line in a `LineData` object by extending from either the **base** (first point) or **distal** (last point) along a direction that follows the local shape of the line near that end. Extension stops when the ray hits a user-selected **reference line** polyline.

### Parameters

- **Reference line data**: `LineData` object whose first line at the reference frame defines the target boundary.
- **Reference frame**: Time index into the reference line data (same convention as Line Clip).
- **Extend at**: `Base` or `Distal` — which end grows toward the reference.
- **Tangent distance (px)**: How far along the line (in pixels, interpolated on the polyline) from the chosen end to sample a second point that defines the extension direction. If this exceeds the line length, the full line is used. Default is 20 px.

### Behavior

If the extension ray does not intersect the reference polyline in the forward direction, the line is left unchanged. Input and reference data must have matching, defined image sizes.

See also: [Line Clip by Reference Line](line_clip.qmd).
